text.en: This Act may be cited as the Seamen's Unemploy- Short title ment lndemnity Act.

ln this Act and in any rules made thereunder unless lnterpretation the context otherwise requires seamen " includes all persons employed on any vessel; vessel " means and includes every kind Of vessel used in navigation.

(1) The owner of a vessel shall be bound to inde- Payment of unemploymnify any seaman employed therein against unemployment ment indemnity resulting from the wreck or loss Of such vessel. ( 2 ) The indemnity shall be paid fo r the days during which such seaman remains in fact unemployed and shall be at the same rate as the wages agreed to be paid to such seaman: Provided that the total amount payable shall not exceed 2 months , wages. ( 3 ) Any money due under this section may be recovered by suit in the appropriate court.
His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Power to make rules Council may from time to time make rules generally fo r the carrying out of the purposes of this Act. B.L.R.O. ) / ) 98
